results.text:
# Drive Medical 1239RD Foldable Rollator Walker with Seat, Red
Brand: Drive Medical
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Walker with Seat: Stylish and modern 2-wheel walker with seat comes with a lightweight frame, a comfortable and convenient padded seat and backrest, and height-adjustable contoured handles for a comfortable grip; Safe and Secure: Wheeled walker features rear leg tips that act as brakes when pressed down for extra safety and protection; equipped with large swivel wheels in front for optimal steering and maneuverability; Foldable Rollator Walker: Lightweight portable rollator easily folds when not in use to be transported with ease; Limited Lifetime Warranty: Your Drive 2 wheel walker is backed by a limited lifetime warranty so you can buy with confidence

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 56.99 USD.
Rated 4.4 from 1917 reviews.
Top review: This walker is what was recommended for stability. My mom could not use four wheeled walkers with handbrakes because her hands aren’t strong enough, and her reflexes are slow. We were worried that a 4-wheeled walker would roll away and cause her to fall. This one works well because it has 2 wheels and does not need handbrakes. It rolls easily, but can’t get away from her and has a seat for when she gets tired. It folds easily enough, though not super easy. I do recommend for those that fall often. Great value for the price too.I am thankful to have found this at an affordable price. It works great for my Mom who is in assisted living. We took her to Lowe's and she used it and was able to sit down on it. Very practical and so useful!Never used a walker before. This was easy for me to handle. It was great for my situation. For now it's my best friend as my foot heals.very niceBought this for my mom for her original walker was from the hospital and does not have a chair. She gets tired and complains of pain by walking just several feet and always looking to sit down. Hence, this was perfect. She loves it, but she finds it hard to maneuver when there's carpet to regular flooring and on gravel or uneven ground. When she wants to sit, we have to position the wheels by a curve or wall for it does not have a break or lock so for safety reason, we do it that way. We have not found it rolling.I would've loved to have given 5 stars - But it was missing 2 screws and washers. My husband had replacement parts - Thank goodness or we would've returned it. It works GREAT, now we can take my Aunt out for longer walking / shopping trips and she can get the rest she needs in between.I bought this for my mom when she started having trouble walking and it works great for her. It is light weight and was very easy to assemble as the bulk of it was already put together. I am very pleased with this product.Very nice! Great to set up and moves in every direction nicely. Stays put when you need it. Love the price!We are stuck with an unsafe walker with missing part.Drive medical has made it very clear that they are not interested in helping us resolve anything. They say that because Amazon has a policy of no returns for personal items, they cannot do anything.I highly recommend other companies who sell walkers who actually do help customers regardless of Amazon policySo you are claiming not accepting returns due to Covid regardless of having its wheels not rolling on the floor properly. So much disappointment. I will never buy medical equipment from Amazon. Covid's spread is almost gone.After 3 months of use, the back leg rollers fell out (spring and roller!. Now down to rubber.......Good chair and seat. Wheels are a little thin but as it is rated for 300 pounds it is sturdy enough.Quick set up (no instructtions came with it) and hand tighten the hand rails. Had to really squeeze one clamp that gets the bolt threaded through it.All in all very happy with unit and easy to use. Just press down on back legs with stoppers.The rear stoppers got worn down from being used outside and there is no replacement part. So now it tears away at carpet and makes large hold in the flooring.

## Details
Model: ‏ ‎ 1239RD

## Description
The Drive Medical Two-Wheeled Walker with Seat works as a great mobility aid if you experience weakness in your legs, have difficulty keeping your balance, or are at risk of falling when walking. Configured with handles like a Rollator, the walker's large swivel front wheels eliminate the need to pick up the unit to advance it, making for smooth, easy movement. The walker comes with a comfortable, convenient seat and backrest that let you take a break wherever you go. Stopping is quick and easy by pressing down on the rear legs to brake. The folding walker unit folds easily when not in use. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty from Drive Medical, a leading brand of mobility aids and other medical goods for more than 20 years, you can buy with confidence.

My father was in need of a walker he didn't need to lift for balance reasons. This was perfect and he is getting around much better with the help of it. ### Very nice walker at an affordable price.

The Drive Rollator arrived within 3 days from Walmart online, although I expected to wait about a week. It was easy to assemble and my granddaughter was able to put it together -- only a couple of pieces were packed separately and had to be put on the walker. It will fit my purposes perfectly and my physical therapist also approved. The only drawback for me is that I cannot fit my portable oxygen tank in the storage bag under the seat, but I am able to hang it on the walker. I wish the bag was a little larger. All in all, this Rollator walker will be perfect for me -- it was great price -- and I will be able to get outside more now.

### Fine product

I bought this rollator for a friend who will be 90 later this month. She lives in an urban apartment and walks to do most of her shopping and errands. She usually walks with just a cane but was wishing for a rollator so she could sit when feeling tired, which happens more and more often. She says this rollator is just what she'd hoped for. It is light enough that she can lift it up a few steps instead of walking the longer way to use ramps. She's very happy that it will easily fold so she can take it along if going somewhere by car.

results.title: Drive Medical Rollator Walker with Seat, 7.5 Inch Wheels, Blue
results.text:
# Drive Medical Rollator Walker with Seat, 7.5 Inch Wheels, Blue
Brand: Drive Medical
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Stable Walking Support: The Drive Rollator Walker delivers reliable mobility assistance and improved balance, featuring a steel frame and a supportive padded seat for daily use; Smooth Indoor & Outdoor Navigation: Designed to support confidence while moving, this rolling mobility aid is built with smooth rolling casters and a secure locking hand brake; Customizable Comfort: Built for personal fit and long-term use, this rollator includes a height adjustment lever along with ergonomic handles and a fold-down backrest for adaptable support; Enhanced Portability: Ideal for active lifestyles, this walker features compact folding for storage plus a convenient under-seat pouch to keep essentials close during travel or everyday errands; Enhancing Lives: Our mission at Drive Medical is to lead the world with innovative healthcare solutions that enhance lives

## Specifications
Color: Blue; Material Type: Alloy Steel; Product Dimensions: 31.5 x 24.5 x 10.75 inches; 20 pounds; Age Range Description: Senior; Global Trade Identification Number: 00822383290331

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 53.99 USD.
Rated 4.6 from 51772 reviews.

## Details
Model: 10257BL-1. UPC: 822383290331

## Description
The Drive 4 Wheel Rollator Walker with Seat is designed to provide dependable support, comfortable mobility, and user-friendly features for seniors, adults, and anyone seeking greater stability. Built with durable steel construction, the rollator offers a strong and steady walking frame that helps users move with confidence whether navigating indoors or outdoors. The thoughtfully designed padded seat provides a comfortable resting spot during longer outings, while the removable hinged backrest adds extra support and can be folded down when not needed. This rollator is equipped with smooth-rolling 7.5-inch caster wheels that help users maintain steady movement across various surfaces, making it suitable for both home and healthcare use. The convenient hand brakes allow for easy speed control and can be locked securely for stationary seating. An under-seat personal item pouch provides a discreet storage solution for essential belongings, supporting everyday independence. With a dependable 350-lb weight capacity and a long-lasting steel frame, this rollator is built to serve as a reliable mobility companion. Its blend of strength, comfort, and ease of use makes it an excellent choice for daily support, rehabilitation needs, or maintaining independence. Founded in 2000, Drive Medical has rapidly become a leading manufacturer of durable medical equipment with offices throughout the world. With the 2015 acquisition of DeVilbiss Healthcare, an innovator in respiratory care since 1888, we expanded to include a full line of reliable oxygen and respiratory products used in more than 100 countries. Our name, Drive Medical, reflects both our dynamic, forward-moving spirit as well as this long legacy of supporting lives.

ASIN: B00NFJX0PU
